canonical_project: Liaoning Unicom Shenyang-Fushun Intelligent Computing Center and AI Center
notes: Sina/Operator Finance reports Liaoning Unicom planned an intelligent computing center and AI center in the Shenyang-Fushun Demonstration Zone with about RMB 1.4 billion total investment, 102 mu land area and 77,600 sqm building area; local government notice records strategic cooperation around a high-spec IDC/data-center project.
